English: Spindle Patch
A simple area where West Slavic nomads spin rough fibers into yarn, forming the base of all weaving efforts.
Weavers Tent
A sturdy felt tent where skilled hands craft basic textiles, providing the tribe with clothing and trade goods.
Loom Hut
A wooden hut sheltering large looms, enabling the creation of more advanced fabrics and increasing output.
Patterned Room
A communal weaving room decorated with traditional Slavic motifs, where skilled artisans collaborate on intricate patterns.
Dye Pavilion
A large canvas pavilion dedicated to dyeing yarns and fabrics, introducing vibrant colors and more valuable goods.
Textile Chamber
A robust timber structure dedicated to mass textile production, employing many hands and supporting the growing nomad horde.
Fine Cloth Hall
A grand hall where rare, high-quality cloth is crafted for trade and prestige, supporting both economy and morale.
Weavers Guildhall
An organized guildhall where master weavers teach apprentices, codifying tradition and raising output even further.
Master Weavers Room
A revered chamber reserved for legendary weavers whose artistry inspires the entire horde and attracts skilled migrants.
West Slavic Weaving Guild
The legendary center of West Slavic weaving, a symbol of unity and prosperity, attracting the best artisans from across the steppe.
